notes.abstract_one_liner: Across 6 Kerr QNM families (total N=1560), we find |Im(ωM)| ∝ (T_H M)^ρ with ρ̄=0.993683±0.001965 (family spread; range [0.990236,0.995716]); the normalized ratio R=|Im(ωM)|/(T_H M) exhibits a near-extremal collapse with plateau median R=5.927 at Δ≤0.05 (16–84%: [2.952,11.658], pooled N=156).
